name: Brooklet · Gremlet #34
description:
A little stream that got up and went for a walk. Its crest curls over when it laughs.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Brooklet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
